stages.name: Salvage over the hazard
stages.law: objective law: the crate's COM stays inside the marked region with its bottom >= 4 mm above the slab top for the whole window; the load path is the admitted contact/weld physics only
stages.falsifier: crate bottom <= slab top + 3 mm at settle (on the hazard) or COM out of the region; rejected edits moving the hash
stages.cell: HELD: crate 305 mm above the hazard; sag 1.0 mm after the stiff re-weld (was 10.7 mm). SOLUTION A accepted.
